model.missingness: omit unavailable dimensions and renormalize available weights

cohort_definition.population: Every property_lookups parcel resolving through the governed lookup_sr1a_subject_evidence RPC after safe compact-key normalization.
cohort_definition.source_transport: Synchronous read-only PostgreSQL http_get against the same canonical assets consumed by workbench-score.

scenario_definition.perturbations: One component weight at a time is multiplied by 0.8 or 1.2 while all other canonical weights remain unchanged. The ROBUST weighted-average denominator naturally renormalizes available scenario weights, including missing components.
scenario_definition.leave_one_out: One component weight is set to zero while the remaining available dimensions renormalize exactly as ROBUST-v1 does.
scenario_definition.rank_metric: Pearson correlation of within-scenario descending raw-score ranks against baseline ranks.
scenario_definition.top_decile: Top 17 of 170 properties using descending raw score with pams_pin tie break.
scenario_definition.band_metric: Migration after production-style integer score rounding against the existing 35/50/65/80 boundaries.

equalization_source_boundary.effect: The seven 85%-coverage cohort rows outside this footprint lack Stability because the canonical equalization asset is South-Jersey-only, not because parcel-level SR-1A evidence failed.

decisions.O_weight: KEEP 20; locally most band-sensitive but ±20% remains rank-stable; LOO confirms substantial unique information
decisions.B_weight: KEEP 30; ±20% remains stable; LOO confirms substantial unique information
decisions.S_weight: KEEP 15; statewide validation remains source-footprint limited
decisions.T_weight: KEEP 10; governed cohort now supports meaningful sensitivity without stale parcel-sale fallback
decisions.gate_reason: Coverage percentage alone does not encode which dimension is absent. A 100% gate would disproportionately exclude the only examples from six non-South-Jersey counties because the canonical equalization asset is not statewide; an 85% gate still admits rows missing Stability while excluding different composition patterns below 85. Preserve evidence coverage/confidence reporting and missing-dimension renormalization until source coverage and property-class representation improve.

limitations: The cohort is sale-observed by construction because governed subject evidence is built from verified SR-1A usable sales.
158 of 170 properties are in Atlantic, Camden, or Gloucester counties; geographic representation is improved but not statewide-balanced.
167 of 170 properties are class 2 and only 3 are class 4A; other property classes are not represented.

The governed O calibration uses the canonical municipal verified-sale PPSF times governed subject living area. User-specific saved comparable-value overrides are intentionally excluded from this warehouse-wide read-only cohort.
Stability cannot be evaluated for seven out-of-footprint properties because equalization-ratios.json currently contains only seven South Jersey counties.
